text:
Ryu Nakamura: Morning! I'm Ryu — joining Eng Platform as an infra engineer. Just finished setting up my desk (2nd floor, by the window) and brought mochi 🍡 from my neighborhood bakery. Also a bit of a nerd for old paper maps — there's a tiny map collection in my bag if anyone wants to trade stickers or recs. Super excited to be here! cc @Maria Gomez

Maria Gomez: Welcome Ryu!! 🎉 So glad to have you. We put you on the #eng-platform orientation at 11 and Ben will add you to the infra rotation doc.

Ben Huang: welcome!! if you want a desk plant, swing by the plant shelf near the pantry — free to adopt. Also ping me when you're ready for a quick tour of the infra setup.

Jo Park: hi Ryu — we have a lunchtime walking group that goes to the pier on Wed. Mochi sounds amazing. where's your favorite bakery?

Ryu Nakamura: @Jo Park it's called MochiMura on Market St — they do sesame and matcha. Also I've got a small stack of vintage atlases (mostly city maps) if anyone wants to swap a comic or recipe for one.

Sam (People Ops): Hey Ryu — onboarding checklist shows badge pickup pending. You can grab it from reception; badge-bot will DM you the pickup code. Also FYI free snacks in the kitchenette on Fridays.

badge-bot: Your badge is ready at reception. Code: 7421. Expiry: 2026-04-30.

Ellie (Design): welcome! if you like maps, you'll like the city-themed sticker wall near the 3rd floor whiteboard — add one!

Ben Huang: Quick FYI for the desk — ethernet port 12A is flaky, so default to Wi-Fi for today. We'll swap cables tomorrow.

Ryu Nakamura: Got it, thx. Bringing mochi to the team kitchen in ~15 if anyone wants some :handshake: 

Maria Gomez: I'll be there! :tada: 

Sam (People Ops): Welcome again, Ryu — happy to help if you need anything.
